# Highgate municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 11; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Highgate (official website, Selectboard page): the town's Selectboard page seats Merry Souza (Chair, term expires March 2027), Henry Rainville (2027), Claude Chevalier (2027), Christopher LaPan (Vice-Chair, 2028), and Chad Carr (2029). Carr's 2029 expiry proves the page postdates the March 2026 meeting (his seat stood and he was re-elected to a three-year term)

Town of Highgate, 2025 Annual Report (official town website): the pre-meeting officers table seats Souza as Chair with Vern Brosky III as Vice-Chair, Richard Flint, Carr (term expired March 2026), and a fifth seat vacant (to 2028)

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): the directory seats Carr, Lapan, and Souza but also Richard Flint as Chair and Vern Brosky III, both absent from the town's current page -- the directory is stale for Highgate and the town's own page governs
Town of Highgate, 2025 Annual Report (official town website): the town officers table prints Town Clerk Wendi Dusablon's term expiring March 2026

17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a town clerk at annual town meeting. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): Highgate Town Clerk is Wendi Dusablon; her printed term expired in March 2026 and no official source publishes the outcome of the 2026 clerk election, so the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed
Town of Highgate, 2025 Annual Report (official town website): the town officers table prints Town Treasurer Shelley Laroche's term running to March 2028
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): Highgate Treasurer is Shelley Laroche
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2026 VT Treasurers' Contact Info' spreadsheet: Highgate Treasurer is Shelley Laroche
Town of Highgate, 2025 Annual Report (official town website): the town officers table prints Town Moderator Phillip Ladue's term expiring March 2026

17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a moderator at annual town meeting. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.

Town of Highgate, 2025 Annual Report (official town website): the town officers table lists five elected Cemetery Commissioners: Kevin Spears (Chair, term expired March 2026), Benjamin Nye (2027), Douglas Nye (2028), Keith Ploof (2029), and Dennis Nolan (2030). Spears's seat stood in 2026 with no published outcome and is left unfilled

Town of Highgate, 2025 Annual Report (official town website): the town officers table lists five elected Library Trustees: Rebecca Manning (Chair, term expired March 2026), Amber Machia (2027), Virginia Holiman (2028), Chelsea Pigeon (2029), and one seat already vacant (to 2030). The two open seats are left unfilled

Town of Highgate, 2025 Annual Report (official town website): the town officers table classes the Delinquent Tax Collector among the town's appointed miscellaneous officials (Shelley Laroche, appointment term expired March 2026). Structure only: the office is filled by appointment and no current appointee is published
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): the listing names six justices of the peace for Highgate
